name: Roommate
source:
Roommate starring lovely model peachfiire is out now!

Sister of your best friend, peachfiire starts living with you. Her brother asks you to keep an eye on her. Are you ready to do anything to make her behave?

[From the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/roommate-demo-78888005]Patreon post[/url]]
translation:
由可爱的模特peachfiire主演的《Roommate》现已推出！

你最好的朋友的妹妹peachfiire搬来与你同住。她的哥哥拜托你照看她。为了让她乖乖听话，你愿意不惜一切吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/roommate-demo-78888005]Patreon帖子[/url]]
